plans.note: Section 15 is captioned as a limitation of Garman's liability only — check for mutuality, cap size relative to fees, exclusion of consequential loss, and carve-outs for the IP indemnity (sec-13), confidentiality (sec-14) and wilful misconduct.

Section 13 is the vendor IP indemnity; confirm defence/settlement mechanics and remedies, whether it is capped by sec-15, and whether any reciprocal indemnity from Sparkling is broader than narrow misuse.
No non-compete heading; only plausible homes are the use restrictions (sec-3) or general matters (sec-20). Confirm sec-3 does not bar us from acquiring or developing competing routing software.
Watch for sole-source language in the licence grant, maintenance (sec-10) or fees (sec-11) requiring us to take support only from Garman.
Check fees (sec-11) for any pricing-parity or best-terms undertaking; an MFN running in our favour would be acceptable and not flagged.
Section 19 is directly on point: test mutuality, duration, scope (only personnel engaged on this project) and whether general advertising/unsolicited applicants are carved out.

Section 17 governs term and termination; also review the rejection option (sec-7/sec-8) and maintenance cancellation rights in sec-10 for our exit on notice and any penalty or accelerated fee on exit.
Maintenance is typically the auto-renewing element — check sec-10/sec-17 for the renewal term, the non-renewal notice window and any uncapped fee uplift in sec-11.
Governing law, venue and any arbitration clause will sit in General Matters (sec-20); confirm the law is an accepted jurisdiction and that disputes go to courts rather than foreign arbitration.
Assignment is normally in sec-20; also check the grant (sec-2) for transfer bans and sec-17 for any Garman termination right triggered by our change of control.
Confirm Garman claims no rights in Sparkling's data (relevant to sec-4 data conversion) or in any modifications/configurations we pay for; cross-check confidentiality (sec-14) and escrow (sec-16).

Section 2 grant plus sec-3 restrictions and the 'Authorized Location' style definitions in sec-1 — test affiliate and contractor use, site/CPU limits, perpetuity and any right for Garman to revoke at will.
Any inspection/verification right over our use of the software would sit in sec-3 or sec-20; check notice, frequency, business-hours limits and who bears cost.
Look for interest on late payment, cancellation charges or stipulated damages in fees (sec-11) or termination (sec-17); service credits running to us are welcome and not flagged.
Section 12 is the specifications and warranty clause; assess warranty duration from acceptance (sec-6), the repair/replace/refund remedy, and whether sec-12 disclaims all other warranties.
No insurance heading; Garman personnel attend our sites for installation and training (sec-4, sec-5, sec-9), so if nothing appears in sec-20 this is a missing-clause request.
Check fees (sec-11) and maintenance (sec-10) for minimum licence counts, committed maintenance years or non-refundable take-or-pay amounts without an exit.

Section 17 likely requires return/destruction of software on termination; verify whether it also gives us our data back and wind-down assistance, with escrow (sec-16) and survival (sec-18) as related hooks.
